title: Backtest Report: {name}
costs_basis_note: Commission and slippage come from the trade diagnostics over all closed trades; total commission over all executions is {total}.
sample_note: Based on {stored} of {total} closed trades kept in the stored result (sampled history).
limitations: Orders fill at bar prices with a fixed slippage rate; order-book depth, queue position and partial fills are not simulated.
Intrabar paths are unknown; stop and take-profit triggers inside one bar are resolved conservatively.
Funding payments, borrow costs and dividends are not included unless listed above.
Past results on historical data do not guarantee future performance.
warning_data_kind: The result was computed on `{kind}` data, not market data.
warning_benchmark_unavailable: Buy-and-hold benchmark unavailable (`{reason}`); the comparison is omitted.
warning_benchmark_partial: Buy-and-hold benchmark covers {ratio} of the backtest bars.
warning_no_signals: The strategy produced no executions in this period.
warning_open_position_only: No trade was closed; results reflect open positions only.
warning_liquidated: The account was liquidated during the backtest.
warning_annualized_capped: Annualized return is capped for display.
warning_sampled_history: Trade history is sampled in storage; distributions use {stored} of {total} trades.
warning_legacy_diagnostics: This run predates trade diagnostics; R multiple, MAE/MFE, holding time and cost breakdown are unavailable.
warning_funding_not_modeled: Funding fees are not modeled; perpetual-futures results may be overstated or understated.
